snippet_primary: "Integrates Payhip into WordPress. When a Payhip product page link is clicked, it will open a Payhip 'Buy' box. To use, just install and activate the plugin. There are no settings, it will automatically work on all links to Payhip product pages, both existing and new ones."
subject_exact: WordPress.org plugin 'WP Payhip Integration' (accessed April 2026) auto-opens Payhip 'Buy' overlay when any Payhip product page link is clicked; zero configuration — activates automatically on all Payhip product links after installation
local_qualifiers: plugin auto-opens Payhip 'Buy' box on product link click; no settings required
activates automatically on all existing and new Payhip links after installation
